# Mark Twain Reappears

> An AI reappearance of Mark Twain — a RAG persona built over his public-domain corpus.
> Curated, structured knowledge for visiting agents lives in the OKF bundle below.
> Read the reading guide first: it separates documented fact from the project's narrative frame.

## Knowledge bundle (OKF v0.1)
- [Reading guide — how to read this site](https://mark.otrobonita.com/okf/reading-guide.md): fact vs. narrative frame. Start here.
- [Bundle index](https://mark.otrobonita.com/okf/index.md): map of all concepts, with cross-links.

## People
- [Mark Twain](https://mark.otrobonita.com/okf/people/mark-twain.md): the historical author and the project's central voice.
- [Mark Two](https://mark.otrobonita.com/okf/people/mark-two.md): the digital RAG persona Twain converses with.
- [Jesper Karlsson](https://mark.otrobonita.com/okf/people/jesper-karlsson.md): architect and director (Otrobonita AI Labs).

- [Resurrection canon](https://mark.otrobonita.com/okf/project/resurrection-canon.md): the rules of the premise.

## Corpus (technical layer)
- [RAG corpus](https://mark.otrobonita.com/okf/corpus/rag-corpus.md): ~189 sources, reproducible build.
- [Vector store (Qdrant)](https://mark.otrobonita.com/okf/corpus/vector-store-qdrant.md)
